Overall, this is a high-quality container that holds water perfectly, and fits our De’Longhi Magnifica plus machine exactly. The only concern was that it is just slightly too small to hold all the water that the machine puts out when descaling. If the container could just be built slightly taller so it can fully handle all the water that the machine puts out, it would be perfect. Overall, it’s still usable, but you do have to pay attention and swap it out with another container briefly when there are pauses in the process, in order to ensure the container doesn’t overflow.

I started looking for a way to extend the drip tray on our Jura E8 to support mugs with wide bases after losing a favorite coffee cup to a tile floor.

I saw clip on plastic extensions, the difference here is this extension is a solid block of material that is printed to exactly match the corner of the Jura drip tray below the milk frother, and is also just the right height to lean the oversized cup slightly toward the machine for stability.

The extension is not attached to the drip tray for good reason:  the drip tray is removed frequently to remove the coffee grounds.  

That said, it is nothing to move the extension to the side, service the tray and move it back both.

Definitely solved the issue that wanted solving.

The extension arrived promptly and well packaged by regular post.
